message: Implement Sv32 paging initialization and update kernel build process
Add debug output for dcache request in soc_top and update testbench to fix CI/CD pipeline failure.

Merge pull request #2 from shaanpatel00/feature/sv32-paging

CSR file + CSRRW decode implemented
TLB + PTW wired into the data path
Real 2-level Sv32 page-table walk verified end-to-end
ptw.sv leaf-PTE level-selection bug fixed
l2_controller.sv stale-write-enable bug (silently dropped every cache-hit write-through to backing memory) fixed
Both pre-existing regressions still pass
Latch L1 write enable signal to prevent stale reads during cache checks
Add end-to-end Sv32 paging integration test
